full_page.content:
Page 84 Cont. Oct. 29 Mrs. Addis McNern - 47 - intestinal cancer - given two weeks to live month ago. Husband not Cath. took lot in Holy Sep. Cemetery ..... En- rolled again To-day.
Robert Hart - Business misunderstandings
30 Carol Repaid - 5% months - Spinal maningitis - Sent home to die "nothing doing" Mother promises to bring child up Cath. if spared ... Mothers folks "Christian Church" - In convulsions for 2 hours. .. brought to Monastery on pillo in convulsions
1938, November
Nov. 1 James Griffith, 52 - on way to Ann Arbor Hospital To-day 6:25 a.m. for operation - badly injured back. Enrolled again in S.M.As'n.
Jos. Hayes, 40 - Thanks - of Maidstone, Ontario - strep-infection re- moval of stone in G. bladder - 108 fever ... here To-day with family of six - drove over himself. Enrolls in thanksgiving
Page 85
Nov. 1 June Van Weil - 16 - lame with tuomer - cancer feared - since June last .... last Wed. not able to walk ... Aunt came to get blessing for her: she started to walk that evening - walked into Monastery To-day just limping a little ....
2 Ignat. Marcios - 49 - Nerveous fears a spirit that seems to pester him cannot sleep, etc. Asked how often he receives the sacraments ..... "I have not received this year .. ." Enrolled in Ser. Mass As'n. and re- quests high Mass ....
Leo Nadratowski - 63 - losing weight - cannot walk ... stomach
Neil Sinclair (Fam. ) 2464 Elmhurst - has flat to rent - 4 blocks from Visitation - 5 rooms heated $45. per month.
Mrs. Anna Smigel - 72 - throat cancer feared - suffers extremely ..... Gerald Rossi - 6 - had broken appendix .... given up. Sept. 26 inscribed in Ser. Masses ... Comes To-day in perfect health - looks like ten.
